description: Myanmar - Geospatial based Least-cost Modeling Output is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans", published or maintained by Shaky Sherpa (Columbia University Earth Institute). This is the data output from the modeling results for the geospatial least-cost planning for universal electricity access by 2030 as part of the the project funded by the World Bank for Myanmar National Electrification Plan (NEP).The dataset list the locations and population as well as the model recommended electrification system for each settlement in ... Coverage: Myanmar. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Policies and plans. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
